pr_body:
The help text says it all:

----

The duration elapsed between having evaluated a BatchRequest and it being
reflected in the proposer's state machine (i.e. having applied fully).

This encompasses time spent in the quota pool, in replication (including
reproposals), and application, but notably *not* sequencing latency (i.e.
contention and latch acquisition).

No measurement is recorded for read-only commands as well as read-write commands
which end up not writing (such as a DeleteRange on an empty span). Commands that
result in 'above-replication' errors (i.e. txn retries, etc) are similarly
excluded. Errors that arise while waiting for the in-flight replication result
or result from application of the command are included.

Note also that usually, clients are signalled at beginning of application, but
the recorded measurement captures the entirety of log application.

Commands that use async consensus will still cause a measurement that reflects
the actual replication latency, despite returning early to the client.

----

Fixes cockroachdb#83262.

Epic: CRDB-25287
Release note (ops change): a histogram metric raft.replication.latency was added.
It tracks the time between evaluation and application of the command. This includes
time spent in the quota pool, in replication (including reproposals) as well as log
application, but notably *not* sequencing latency, i.e. contention and latch
acquisition.

issue_context.title: kvserver: replication latency metrics
issue_context.body:
**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**

Related to https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/82200. We don't currently have a latency histogram of replication latencies.

**Describe the solution you'd like**

Add a field `createdAtTS` to `*ProposalData` that is populated here:

https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/blob/034611b5a4e9616d8dbce47379542786fe1adf16/pkg/kv/kvserver/replica_proposal_buf.go#L1174-L1182

On the first (!) call to

https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/blob/09e60c0616ad2b6d76ce3abae5b7336f0181ebe1/pkg/kv/kvserver/replica_proposal.go#L142-L149

compute `timeutil.Since(p.createdAtTS)` and add it to a latency histogram `kv.replication.latency`. The help text for that metric should make clear that-

- what is being measured is the time taken to replicate (i.e. durably append to the raft log on a quorum) a proposal (i.e. post evaluation and post acquiring proposal quota) and materialize the result of the proposal on the proposing replica
- in particular, for a pipelined write (where a client gets their response early, before an intent resulting from a write becomes replicated) we also measure the "correct" full replication latency
- that we measure even on error, i.e. a proposal that fails after 4s with an ambiguous result, for example, will still get measured
- that measurements are collected on all replicas (i.e. not just the leaseholder), i.e. if a follower requests a lease and gets stuck for 20s it will also record a 20s measurement
- that we're not measuring the latency of Raft heartbeats (we can't since they are coalesced and artificially slowed down) but just real payloads.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**


**Additional context**

`*ProposalData` already has a `createdAtTicks` field, we should consider making the functionality that relies on that field use the new `createdAtTS` field, if possible.


Jira issue: CRDB-16959
